read.thesis: Record Q1 FY27 revenue $935M and backlog above $5.5B, but a 45X credit of $99M lifted gross margin and FY27 outlook was raised mainly on the new power-conversion push and acquisitions.

triggers.label: Acquisitions and power conversion entry
triggers.quote: Expanded Nextpower’s clean power technology platform through acquisition of the Prevalon energy storage business as well as Apex Power

triggers.label: 45X credit $99M inside gross profit
